nodes.label: Stack validation: second opinion, no layer revised
nodes.rationale: Layer-by-layer validation with cited alternatives, failure stories, scale narrative to 1M MAU, and a risk register. Requested by Claudio at the Phase 5 gate (DEC-008).

nodes.label: Condition: Supabase with EU region, on-device health line, auth containment, off-platform backups
nodes.rationale: The on-device health data line keeps compliance at $25/month instead of $950+; auth blast radius contained via own API layer keeps the exit a 2 to 4 week project.

nodes.label: Condition: Hetzner with off-provider backups, IaC, restore drill, OVH fallback runbook
nodes.rationale: Hetzner has a documented pattern of abrupt automated account suspensions and no published SLA; the conditions reduce impact from critical to low.

nodes.label: Risk: GraphHopper US-wide foot-graph memory sizing unproven (week-one load test mandatory)
nodes.rationale: Public sizing evidence is car-profile-biased; import peak is often conflated with serving footprint.

nodes.label: Verdict: Vercel serves research artifacts only, never the app backend
nodes.rationale: Vercel Functions cap at 4 GB and 30 minutes with no persistent processes; GraphHopper's persistent multi-GB JVM structurally cannot run there.

edges.rationale: Second opinion on the original recommendation: no layer revised.
